messages:
morgan: Hey team — we need a 60m security review roundtable next week to cover Payments v2 threat model and the updated access matrix. Prefer to keep it focused: threat surface, mitigations, and owner signoffs.

morgan: Proposed slots: Tue 11:00-12:00 PT or Thu 15:00-16:00 PT. Which works? If neither, suggest an alternate time.

morgan: Pre-reads: design doc + current access spreadsheet + SSO audit notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/payments-v2-threat-model (please skim the threat sections)

morgan: Draft agenda (will iterate):
```
1) 5m - quick context & goals
2) 20m - threat model walkthrough (Priya + Kai)
3) 20m - access matrix review (Jordan)
4) 10m - action items & owners
5) 5m - follow-ups / compliance next steps
```

kai: Thu 3pm PT works best for me. Tue morning tough.

priya: I can do Tue 11 but prefer Thu if Jordan needs it. I can run the threat model portion either way.

jordan: Thu would be ideal — I'm heads down Tue morning. Thu 3-4 PT for me.

paula: Thu works. Can infra/security infra owners (cc @sre-oncall) join for the KV/DB auth bits?

sre-oncall: I can do Thu 3-4. Will join for DB auth/rotation discussion.

morgan: Sounds like Thu 15:00 PT is the common slot. I'm going to create a calendar event and attach the doc + action tracker. Please mark "must attend" if you're an owner.

morgan: @paula @priya @kai @jordan please add any extra agenda items here. Anything I'm missing re: compliance checks?

paula: Add a quick item for KMS key rotation cadence and audit log retention (5m).

kai: Also add: fallback plan if a model rollout requires a change (very short).

priya: Will post a short threat checklist in the doc by EOD.

morgan: Thanks. If anyone can't make Thu, record will be posted and follow-up notes with owners assigned.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Payments v2 — Security Review Roundtable" Thu Mar 14 15:00-16:00 PT. Invitees: morgan, priya, kai, jordan, paula, sre-oncall. Link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/event/1965432100

jordan: Got the invite. Marked Must Attend.

priya: Added checklist and a short threat heatmap to the doc.

morgan: Great — prep items: read heatmap, review access matrix, bring any open PRs that touch auth paths.

paula: Will bring KMS rotation notes + retention policy.

morgan: OK closing out here. See you Thu. Posting follow-ups in thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
